integrity: The universal statement is proved symbolically. The bundled finite checker only replays the pair reduction and exponent criterion over bounded integer ranges; it is not used as evidence for the infinite quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The classification is only for minimal support-two ideals with star base graph and one generator per edge; it does not address general co-chordal graphs, non-minimal support-two ideals, or powers.
title: Componentwise linearity on minimal support-two stars
